diagnosis: Check C1, which is supposed to depend on the hidden fact PF1 (Patient R's exact requirement of 4 L/min), passed in all four rollouts despite the models never having access to PF1. The models correctly assigned the concentrator to Patient R based solely on shared facts S1, S2, and S3, making the decision trivial without the hidden information.

C1.why: Patient R's exact continuous requirement of 4 L/min changes the assignment from an unresolved choice to R and changes the concentrator setting to exactly 4 L/min.
